env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd w
logos build ./...
logos build -o $WORK/bin/ro$GOEXE ./g/cmd
exec $WORK/bin/ro$GOEXE
stdout '^ro-ok$'
cd ..

env GOWORK=off
cd w/l
logos eject -o bout
exists bout/r/r.go
grep ' Name\(\) string' bout/r/r.go
grep ' Extra\(\) int' bout/r/r.go
grep ' Sum\(xs \[\]int\) int' bout/r/r.go
! grep 'const Name' bout/r/r.go
! grep 'const \[\]int' bout/r/r.go
! grep -E 'Logos_Get|Logos_Set' bout/r/r.go
cd bout
go build ./...
cd ..
cd ../..

-- w/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./l
	./g
)

-- w/l/go.mod --
module example.com/l

go 1.27

-- w/l/r/r.lgo --
package r

type Readable interface {
	const Name() string
	Extra() int
}

type Thing struct{}

func (Thing) Name() string {
	return "name"
}

func (Thing) Extra() int {
	return 7
}

func Use(v Readable) string {
	return v.Name()
}

func Sum(xs const []int) int {
	total := 0
	for _, v := range xs {
		total += v
	}
	return total
}

-- w/g/go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27

-- w/g/q/q.go --
package q

import "example.com/l/r"

var _ r.Readable = r.Thing{}

func Run() string {
	var t r.Thing
	if t.Name() != "name" {
		return "bad-direct"
	}
	var v r.Readable = t
	if v.Name() != "name" {
		return "bad-iface"
	}
	if r.Use(t) != "name" {
		return "bad-use"
	}
	if v.Extra() != 7 {
		return "bad-extra"
	}
	if got := r.Sum([]int{1, 2, 3}); got != 6 {
		return "bad-sum"
	}
	return "ro-ok"
}

-- w/g/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/g/q"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(q.Run()) }
